Official NFL team index — depth route provenance

The 2026-11-17 depth sweep used this league team index to obtain the official club-site links, then captured the 32 club /team/depth-chart pages. Per-club URLs and observed page structures are listed in nfl-depth-sweep/pages/sources.html; 31 were HTML tables and Houston was image-only. This is route/page evidence, not proof of game-day starters or playing time.
